tickerText: [TENNIS] Alex de Minaur double-faulted on match point and fell to Cameron Norrie 5-7, 7-6 (5), 6-1 in Montreal as Aryna Sabalenka beat Zhang Shuai 6-3, 6-4 and Iga Swiatek rolled past Viktorija Golubic 6-2, 6-1 in Toronto • [SQUASH] PSA Squash Tour sets a record $13.5M in 2025–26 prize money across 1,297 events as Assore Tour Challenger semis play out in Johannesburg • [BADMINTON] BAI unveils fully renovated IGI Stadium ahead of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, August 17–23, with Ayush Shetty set to face Shi Yu Qi in the opener • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Tour Europe launches a 20-event, nine-country circuit with €545K on offer as the Carvana PPA Tour debuts unified World Pickleball Rankings for 2026–27 • [TABLE TENNIS] Miwa Harimoto rallies from 0-2 to reach Yokohama quarterfinals; Sreeja Akula claims her first WTT Champions win and Sora Matsushima opens with a round-of-32 victory at BUNTAI

newsItems.title: De Minaur Fumbles Match Point
newsItems.excerpt: Alex de Minaur double-faulted on match point and lost to Cameron Norrie 5-7, 7-6 (5), 6-1 in Montreal as the Canadian Open men's draw thins further.

newsItems.title: Delhi Venue Ready for Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: BAI says Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium has been fully renovated ahead of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, August 17–23.

newsItems.title: PSA Sets Prize Money Record
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Squash Tour reported $13.5M in total prize money for 2025–26 — an 8% rise with 1,297 sanctioned events across 81 countries.

newsItems.title: PPA Tour Europe Debuts
newsItems.excerpt: PPA Tour Europe launches with 20 events across nine countries and a €545,000 prize pool, culminating in the PPA Finals Europe in May 2027.
